Pacific Care Pet Emergency & Specialty
PROVIDING EXCEPTIONAL CARE TO THE IRVINE, CA COMMUNITY
Our 12,000 sq. ft. veterinary specialty and emergency hospital has the specialists, innovative technology, and equipment needed to provide the best care possible for your pets. Our board-certified specialists and 24/7 emergency team provide comprehensive and compassionate care to Irvine, Tustin, Santa Ana, and the surrounding areas.

Who We Are
Conveniently located in Irvine, our hospital has the specialists and equipment needed to provide the best care possible.
Working in partnership with primary care veterinarians, our mission is to improve the quality of life of our patients through care, collaboration, and comprehensive treatment.
